t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each gnome corresponds to a colour of basket. One basket will do really well for a while and then slowly diminish. At this point it would be wise to choose a gnome that gives you the other colour basket. Keep an eye on x5 and x1 multipliers as well.

vb_textbox.text: There are two different colour baskets. Red and yellow. It seems random which basket gives you more points. It'll be red for a couple of turns and then switch to yellow. Each gnome corresponds to a basket colour. Learning these will allow you to continue a streak of clicking on the same colour basket. The big points comes from the x5 multiplier.
